events.name: Shrewsbury Django Fest 2026
events.description: Three-day gypsy jazz festival. Friday concert doors open at 7pm; Saturday and Sunday include free daytime jam sessions, with evening concerts. Evening tickets start at £23 and a weekend ticket is £95.

events.name: Hedgerows in the Hills
events.description: A weekend celebrating Shropshire countryside and hedgerows with walks, talks, demonstrations, country crafts and children's activities. Adults £6; under-16s free.
events.source_name: Acton Scott Heritage Farm / CPRE Shropshire

events.name: Play Time @ The Library – Oswestry
events.description: Free interactive sensory play session for children aged 0–5 and their grown-ups. Designed for children to explore, connect and grow together. Limited availability; booking is required with Oswestry Library staff by phone or email, or via the library’s Facebook page. Parental supervision is required.
events.age_guidance: Ages 0–5 with grown-ups; parental supervision required.

events.name: Parents & Toddlers / Bumps & Babes – Stretton Parish
events.description: A welcoming weekly term-time group for parents and carers with toddlers and babies, as well as expectant parents. Children can explore toys and activities, with a shared snack around 10:45 and singing around 11:45. All the family is welcome. Suggested donation £1 per session per family. Runs every Thursday during term time, 10:00–12:00.
events.accessibility: Parish Centre venue information confirms a hearing loop. High chairs are available at the group; a dedicated baby area is always available.
events.age_guidance: Parents/carers with toddlers and babies, plus expectant parents; all family welcome.

events.name: Coffee and Chat – Ellesmere Library
events.description: Free monthly information, advice and support session covering family life, SEND, parenting, mental health, carers, housing and finance, domestic abuse support, food share, health promotion and social isolation. Official Shropshire Council listing confirms 17 September 2026, 09:30–11:30. Recurs 15 October, 19 November and 17 December 2026, all 09:30–11:30. No specific age limit or booking requirement is stated, so none is inferred.
events.accessibility: Ellesmere Library is officially listed as autism friendly, with disabled access, disabled parking and level entry access.
events.age_guidance: No specific age stated; family life, SEND and parenting support are explicitly included.

events.name: Messy Church – Stretton Parish Centre
events.description: Monthly all-ages family gathering with games, crafts, messy activities, a contemporary Bible story, refreshments and a meal together. Runs on the second Thursday of each month except August, 15:30–17:45. The official source does not state a price or booking requirement, so these are left unspecified.
events.accessibility: Stretton Parish Centre venue information confirms a hearing loop.
